children: Catapult Sports' bull at Bell Potter thinks the share-price drop that followed the athletic-tech provider's first-half earnings miss is overdone. Analyst Chris Savage acknowledges that statutory Ebitda of US$3.5 million fell well short of the US$7.9 million consensus forecast, but points out in a note that this was driven by the accounting treatment of a recent large acquisition rather than its underlying operations. Savage makes little change to his forecasts for annualized contract value, revenue and adjusted Ebitda. Bell Potter keeps a buy rating on the stock, with an unchanged target price of 4.65 Australian dollars. Shares are up 1.3% at A$3.06. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
